name: rumokit
description: Portable coding-agent workflows to clarify intent, adapt the process, and verify the outcome.

interface.shortDescription: Help your agent build what you actually meant
interface.longDescription: Clarify the intended outcome, select the skills the task needs, and verify the final result against what the user agreed. Planning, tests, reviews, and subagents adapt to the work.
defaultPrompt: Establish the intended outcome, implement this change, and verify the result against what we agreed.
Fix this bug at its root cause and verify the real behavior.
Review this cross-repository change and its integration order.
